title: Quarantine legacy native-profile address fixtures
description: Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-1k3i: test/vectors/yggdrasil-derivation.json, the lichen_native_sha512 vectors in test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json, and test/vectors/yggdrasil.json encode the rejected SHA-512 native address profile and are still cross-referenced as conformance oracles by spec prose (03-addressing.md, 04-network.md) and code tests (rust/lichen-core/tests/yggdrasil_addr_vectors.rs, python/tests/crypto/test_yggdrasil_address_vectors.py). Per AGENTS.md these are conflicting legacy fixtures to be reported, not conformance oracles. Decide and execute: delete, move to a clearly-labeled legacy/quarantine file, or regenerate against upstream AddrForKey; update all referencing tests and prose. Do not weaken the pinned upstream_addr_for_key byte-equality vector.
